messages.subject: reactiveValues on shinyApps
parts:
Do reactiveValues behave differently on shinyApps vs on a local machine? I have a part of my app that increases the number of textInputs based on the number of times an actionButton is pressed. That number is a reactiveValue, and it works correctly when ran locally, but the textInputs disappear when it is clicked on my shinyApp.

Thanks!
Josh

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] reactiveValues on shinyApps
parts:
Josh, I think I know what this is. If you add this to your app:

output$debuginfo <- renderPrint({
  str(reactiveValuesToList(input))
})

and a corresponding verbatimTextOutput("debuginfo") in ui.R, I think you'll find that when run on ShinyApps.io there are a couple of "hidden" inputs that are being sent along and included in your input object. So you'll either have to remove these values from x, or construct x explicitly by grabbing the pieces you want from input rather than converting the whole thing.
